  /* ---------- background ---------- */

  .dot-b{left:600px;bottom:0;width:720px;height:96px;opacity:.16;}

  .gl1{left:480px;} .gl2{left:960px;} .gl3{left:1440px;}

  /* ---------- frame ---------- */

  .rt1{top:150px;} .rt2{top:540px;} .rt3{top:900px;}
  .rail-label{position:absolute;left:44px;top:560px;z-index:15;transform:rotate(-90deg);transform-origin:left top;
    font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:5px;color:#637067;white-space:nowrap;}

  /* ---------- header ---------- */
  .kicker{position:absolute;left:96px;top:64px;z-index:12;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:5px;color:#4f5b53;}
  .doc-tag{position:absolute;right:96px;top:64px;z-index:12;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:3px;color:#6b7568;}
  .big-index{position:absolute;right:118px;top:116px;z-index:2;font-size:200px;line-height:.86;letter-spacing:0;color:rgba(79,94,67,.11);}
  .title{position:absolute;left:92px;top:96px;z-index:12;margin:0;font-size:94px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:8px;line-height:1.08;color:#1B2620;}
  .lead{position:absolute;left:96px;top:250px;z-index:12;margin:0;width:1120px;padding-left:24px;
    border-left:3px solid var(--theme-accent-secondary);
    font-size:23px;line-height:1.7;letter-spacing:.6px;color:#4d574f;}

  /* ---------- touchpoint cards ---------- */
  .tp{position:absolute;top:318px;width:552px;height:346px;padding:32px 36px 28px;z-index:8;
    background:linear-gradient(178deg,rgba(255,255,255,.70) 0%,rgba(243,240,231,.52) 100%);
    border:1px solid rgba(27,38,32,.16);}
  .tp1{left:96px;} .tp2{left:684px;} .tp3{left:1272px;}
